# QVAC Test Suite v0.12.2 Release Notes

📦 **NPM:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/@qvac/test-suite/v/0.12.2

Generated mobile consumers move to react-native-bare-kit 0.16, and a test skipped by several platform rules now tells each leg only its own reason.

The bare-kit move is a breaking change for anyone generating a mobile consumer: it needs an `@qvac/sdk` whose Expo plugin links addons itself.

---

## Breaking Changes

### Mobile consumers need react-native-bare-kit 0.16

The mobile consumer template now declares `react-native-bare-kit` `^0.16.0`, up from `^0.12.3`.

react-native-bare-kit 0.16 removed `link.mjs`, its bare-link dependency, the Gradle link task and the podspec `prepare_command`, so apps now link native addons themselves. `@qvac/sdk`'s Expo plugin does that with bare-link 4 during `expo prebuild`, linking only the addons the worker bundle loads. A consumer generated by this release therefore has to pair with an `@qvac/sdk` that ships that linker; an older SDK on bare-kit 0.16 links no addons at all.

**Before:**

```json
{ "dependencies": { "react-native-bare-kit": "^0.12.3" } }
```

**After:**

```json
{ "dependencies": { "react-native-bare-kit": "^0.16.0" } }
```

Prebuild links the addons, and reinstalling packages clears them, so run `npx expo prebuild` again after an install.

## New APIs

### Each leg reports only its own skip reason

When several platform-skip rules match one test, the catalog merges them into one skip whose `reason` joins every rule's reason. Every leg then reported the whole string — an Android leg showed the Electron, Snap and iOS reasons next to its own, which made skip lists noisy and hard to read.

`SkipInfo` gains an optional `reasons` list of `{ platforms, reason }` groups, in both the Zod schema and `schema/test-definition.schema.json`:

```typescript
const skip: SkipInfo = {
  reason: 'electron, snap: too slow for the packaged pass | mobile: OOM on device',
  platforms: ['electron', 'snap', 'mobile'],
  reasons: [
    { platforms: ['electron', 'snap'], reason: 'too slow for the packaged pass' },
    { platforms: ['mobile'], reason: 'OOM on device' }
  ]
}
// a mobile-android leg reports: "OOM on device"
```

Whether a test is skipped is still decided by `platforms` alone; `reasons` only changes what is reported, so a group can never widen a skip. When several groups match a leg they are joined the same way `reason` is, for example `too slow for the packaged pass | OOM on device`. The field is optional: catalogs without it, or where no group matches, fall back to `reason`, and older consumers ignore it and keep showing the merged string.
